fact: ANIP's mobile app includes Seyna, an AI-built chatbot that answers frequently asked questions and helps users make requests, presented at a press conference on 14 February 2025.

La Marina BJ reports that GPT BJ, the government's virtual assistant launched in 2023, answers citizens' questions on the tax, digital, labour and penal codes, and that the agency ASIN is preparing an expansion funded by the national budget.
